Available Species

Providentia does not define or control the list of available species. All species are dictated by GHOST (Globally Harmonised Observations in Space & Time).

For a full description of GHOST and its standards, see the GHOST reference paper.

Supported GHOST Versions

Depending on the version specified in ghost_version in the configuration file, the available species may vary. Providentia currently supports the following GHOST versions:

  • 1.2

  • 1.3

  • 1.3.1

  • 1.3.2

  • 1.3.3

  • 1.4

  • 1.5

  • 1.5.1

Check Available Species

As explained above, the available species depend on the selected GHOST version. For each version, the supported species are listed below on this page. A link to the corresponding GHOST_standards.py file used by Providentia is also provided for additional context on the GHOST standards used.
